newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends firm on liquidty squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends firm on liquidty squeeze.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed firmer at 485.25/486.25 per dollar as the interbank overnight lending rate roared ahead to 70 percent prompting banks to switch into bolivars, trader said.
The bolivar closed Monday at 486.00/487.00 per dollar.
"There was strong interbank dollar offerings," said one trader. "It may have had to do with the need for bolivars for tomorrow's TEM auction," said one trader.
Venezuela's Central Bank is due to offer 140 billion bolivars ($289 million) of TEM paper at its regular Wednesday auction.

Traders said the bolivar liquidity squeeze drove up interbank overnight lending rates to a 90 percent high, from last week's average 10 percent level, although the rate leveled out at an average 70 percent by day's end.
